detail.abstract: Beginning in March 2018, as part of its Long Finance initiative, Z/Yen published the first five editions of the Global Green Finance Index with the generous support of the MAVA Foundation, and more recently with support from Abu Dhabi Global Market. Z/Yen continues this work and is pleased to present the sixteenth edition of the Global Green Finance Index (GGFI 16). Z/Yen helps organisations make better choices-our clients consider us a commercial think-tank that spots, solves, and acts. Our name combines Zen and Yen-'a philosophical desire to succeed'-in a ratio, recognising that all decisions are trade-offs. One of Z/Yen's specialisms is the development and publication of research combining factor analysis and professional assessments. Long Finance is a Z/Yen initiative designed to address the question "When would we know our financial system is working?" This question underlies Long Finance's goal to improve society's understanding and use of finance over the long-term. In contrast to the short-termism that defines today's economic views the Long Finance time-frame is roughly 100 years.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了由Z/Yen研究机构发布的第十六版全球绿色金融指数（GGFI 16），该指数自2018年3月起作为Long Finance计划的一部分发布，用于评估和排名全球各金融中心在绿色金融领域的表现。
AI.research_question: 全球各金融中心在绿色金融领域的发展水平如何排名和评估？
AI.motivation: Z/Yen旨在通过Long Finance倡议推动社会对金融的长期理解和使用，以对抗当前经济观点中的短期主义，而绿色金融指数的发布正是这一长期目标的具体体现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合因子分析与专业评估的研究方法论；Long Finance的长期金融理念（约100年时间维度）
AI.method: 因子分析结合专业评估（factor analysis and professional assessments）
AI.findings: 发布了第十六版全球绿色金融指数（GGFI 16），对全球各金融中心的绿色金融表现进行排名。
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色金融领域的全球比较研究提供了系统性指标体系和分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球各金融中心提供绿色金融发展水平的量化参考基准，辅助政策制定者和投资者做出更优决策；推动绿色金融在全球范围内的长期发展。

title: Racialized Red Tape: Unraveling Administrative Burdens in Liquor Licensing
affiliations: University of Oregon - School of Law

detail.title: Racialized Red Tape: Unraveling Administrative Burdens in Liquor Licensing
detail.abstract: Americans often bemoan 'red tape' as cumbersome but necessary formalities within administrative governance. Though frustrating, red tape seems to assuage public confidence by portraying bureaucratic decisionmaking as democratic, thorough, and-most importantlyimpartial. This Article counters that passive frame, repositioning administrative procedures as active producers of structural inequity. Drawing on the experiences of small minority-owned businesses seeking to obtain or retain liquor licenses, this Article constructs regulatory bodies as sites that delineate access, agency, and belonging among marginalized groups despite decades of equity interventions. Part I contextualizes liquor licensing within this endeavor, situating it as an unassuming administrative practice that underlies historical and contemporary disparities in spatial and economic autonomy. Part II evaluates the role of state agencies and agents in advancing "racialized administrative burdens," or the learning, psychological, and compliance barriers that conceal exclusionary practices. Relying on qualitative focused case narratives, Part III interprets how racialized administrative burdens in liquor licensing are both operationalized and insulated through normative appeals to neutrality and public safety. Part IV prescribes “historically informed rulemaking” as an analytical framework for rule design and enforcement in contested regulatory domains. This Article invites legal scholars, policymakers, and agency officials to take seriously the distributive properties of bureaucratic procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了行政程序作为"繁文缛节"的被动框架，将行政程序重新定位为结构性不平等的积极生产者。通过研究少数族裔小企业获取或保留酒类许可证的经历，文章论证监管机构是划定边缘群体准入、能动性和归属感的场所，并提出"基于历史信息的规则制定"作为解决争议性监管领域规则设计与执行的框架。
AI.research_question: 行政程序如何通过"种族化的行政负担"积极生产结构性不平等，尤其是在酒类许可证审批这一看似中立的行政实践领域？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为"繁文缛节"虽繁琐但能通过展示决策的民主性、彻底性和公正性来增强公众信心。本文旨在反驳这一被动框架，揭示行政程序作为结构性不平等的积极生产者这一被忽视的面向，尤其是在种族化语境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 种族化行政负担理论（学习、心理与合规障碍）；行政程序作为分配性机制的规范性框架；基于历史信息的规则制定分析框架
AI.method: 定性聚焦案例叙述法（qualitative focused case narratives），基于少数族裔小企业获得或保留酒类许可证的经验材料
AI.findings: 酒类许可证审批中的种族化行政负担通过三种方式运作：学习障碍（信息获取困难）、心理障碍（羞辱与排斥感）和合规障碍（程序性壁垒），且这些排斥性实践通过"中立性"和"公共安全"的规范性主张得以掩盖和正当化，即使经过数十年的平等干预仍持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行政程序从被动框架重新定位为主动的结构性不平等生产者；提出并阐释"种族化行政负担"概念；提出"基于历史信息的规则制定"作为分析框架，为法律学者理解行政程序的分配性质提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行政机构提供"基于历史信息的规则制定"作为监管规则设计与执行的实用框架；呼吁法律学者、政策制定者和机构官员重视行政程序中的分配属性，以应对争议性监管领域中的结构性不平等。

title: Literature Review on Relating government type to the implementation of Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) in the ASEAN Region

detail.title: Literature Review on Relating government type to the implementation of Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) in the ASEAN Region

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship to any organization reviewed in the literature review
declarations.ethicsApproval: No participants involved in the review

detail.abstract: Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) has become an important component of global efforts to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals, with governments playing a central role in its integration into national education and sustainable development policies. However, limited research has examined how different forms of government influence ESD implementation, particularly in the diverse political context of Southeast Asia. This literature review examines the relationship between government type and ESD implementation in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) by synthesizing literature on governance, climate change, sustainable development, and education, alongside country-level ESD policies and strategies. The review finds that ASEAN countries demonstrate diverse approaches to ESD across different government types, with no clear or consistent relationship between regime type and the presence or implementation of ESD policies. Factors such as political stability, economic conditions, governance capacity, international assistance, and stakeholder participation appear to interact with government structures in shaping ESD outcomes. The review therefore suggests that government type alone is insufficient to explain differences in ESD implementation across ASEAN. Further quantitative and qualitative research is needed to examine the specific institutional and contextual factors that enable or constrain ESD integration in the region.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对东盟十国政府类型与可持续发展教育（ESD）实施之间关系的文献综述，发现政府类型与ESD政策实施之间没有明确或一致的关系，政治稳定性、经济条件、治理能力、国际援助和利益相关者参与等因素与政府结构共同影响ESD成效。政府类型本身不足以解释东盟各国ESD实施的差异。
AI.research_question: 不同政府类型如何影响东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）各国可持续发展教育（ESD）的实施？
AI.motivation: ESD已成为实现可持续发展目标的重要组成部分，政府在其中发挥核心作用。然而，现有研究对政府形式如何影响ESD实施关注不足，尤其是在政治多样化的东南亚背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了治理理论、气候变化理论、可持续发展理论和教育理论的相关文献，结合国家层面的ESD政策与战略。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合有关治理、气候变化、可持续发展与教育的文献，并结合东盟各国的ESD政策与战略进行分析。
AI.findings: 东盟各国在不同政府类型下展现出多样化的ESD实施方式，政府类型与ESD政策存在与否及实施情况之间没有明确或一致的关系。政治稳定性、经济条件、治理能力、国际援助和利益相关者参与等因素与政府结构相互作用，共同塑造ESD成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了政府类型直接决定政策实施效果的传统假设，提出政府类型单独不足以解释ESD实施差异，强调需要关注制度性和情境性因素的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东盟各国制定和优化ESD政策提供参考，指出需要进一步研究该地区ESD整合的具体制度与情境因素，以更有效地推进可持续发展目标。

title: Cash Conversion Cycle Management, Pro tability, and Crisis Resilience: Evidence from Brazilian Private Firms (2009 2024)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics

detail.title: Cash Conversion Cycle Management, Pro tability, and Crisis Resilience: Evidence from Brazilian Private Firms (2009 2024)
detail.abstract: We examine how the cash conversion cycle (CCC) relates to rm pro tability and nancial resilience across normal and crisis periods, using a balanced panel of 87 Brazilian privately held rms over 2009 2024. Extending prior work on working capital management in emerging markets, we exploit the COVID-19 pandemic as an exogenous shock to decompose the mechanisms through which crises disrupt CCC components. Estimating dynamic panel regressions via generalized method of moments (GMM) and a di erence-in-di erences (DID) design, we con rm that shorter CCC improves return on assets (ROA) but not return on equity (ROE). Crucially, we document a sharp and asymmetric disruption in the payment cycle during 2020: days payable outstanding collapsed from a pre-crisis average of 24,149 to 1,604 a reduction of over 93% while days sales outstanding and days inventory outstanding remained broadly stable. This nding reveals that supplier-side trade credit contraction was the primary working capital mechanism of COVID-19 for private Brazilian rms. Using a quadrant framework based on rms’ equity and receivables pro les, we show that the shock was concentrated among low-equity/high-receivables rms (DID ≈ 47,000, p < 0.05), while high-equity/low-receivables rms were entirely insulated. The CCC values reported throughout this paper are measured in the natural unit of the ValorPRO database (see Section 3 for a detailed discussion of scale and plausibility).

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2009-2024年87家巴西私营企业的平衡面板数据，检验现金转换周期（CCC）与企业盈利能力和财务韧性的关系。通过GMM动态面板回归和DID设计，确认更短的CCC能提升ROA但不提升ROE；COVID-19疫情期间应付账款天数骤降93%以上，供应商贸易信贷收缩是巴西私企面临的主要营运资金冲击机制，且冲击集中在低权益/高应收款企业。
AI.research_question: 现金转换周期（CCC）如何影响私营企业的盈利能力和财务韧性？在危机时期（如COVID-19）中，CCC的哪些组成部分受到冲击以及冲击如何在不同企业特征间差异化分布？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场私营企业的营运资金管理研究不足，且缺乏利用外生冲击识别危机中CCC构成部分传导机制的实证证据。COVID-19提供了一个天然的外生冲击来分解危机干扰CCC各组成部分的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营运资金管理理论；贸易信贷理论；现金转换周期（CCC）框架
AI.method: 使用2009-2024年87家巴西私营企业的平衡面板数据，采用广义矩估计（GMM）动态面板回归和双重差分（DID）设计；基于企业权益和应收账款特征构建象限框架进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）更短的CCC提升ROA但不提升ROE；（2）2020年疫情期间应付账款天数从疫情前均值24,149骤降至1,604（降幅超93%），而应收账款天数和存货天数基本稳定；（3）供应商贸易信贷收缩是COVID-19对巴西私营企业的主要营运资金冲击机制；（4）冲击集中于低权益/高应收账款企业（DID≈47,000, p<0.05），高权益/低应收账款企业完全免疫。
AI.theory_contributions: 将现金转换周期研究拓展至新兴市场私营企业情境，并利用外生冲击（COVID-19）分解了危机影响CCC各组成成分的具体传导机制，识别出供应商侧贸易信贷收缩作为主要渠道，丰富了危机期间营运资金管理的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场私营企业管理者在正常与危机时期优化营运资金策略提供实证依据，提示企业应注重与供应商关系的韧性建设，并为政策制定者在危机中识别最脆弱的企业类型（低权益/高应收款）提供参考。

title: Georgia Man Arrested Trespassing in His Home
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Atlanta's John Marshall Law School

detail.title: Georgia Man Arrested Trespassing in His Home

contentType.other: A finished publication not yet published

detail.abstract: On March 19, 2024, a seventy-seven-year-old Georgia homeowner was arrested for trespassing in his own home after it was sold through a disputed foreclosure. A review of Vines v. LaSalle Bank shows why Georgia law remains unreliable at keeping elders in their homes after title theft. Drawing on Illinois law, this article recommends that Georgia adopt Illinois's readymade, reliable model for keeping elders in their homes after title theft.

AI.tldr: 本文以Vines v. LaSalle Bank案为切入点，指出乔治亚州法律在老年人遭遇房产所有权盗窃（title theft）后无法可靠保障其继续居住的权利，并建议乔治亚州借鉴伊利诺伊州成熟的立法模式来保护老年人的安居权益。
AI.research_question: 乔治亚州法律在老年人遭遇房产所有权盗窃后，如何有效保障其继续居住在自己家中的权利？
AI.motivation: 2024年3月19日，乔治亚州一名77岁房主因房产在争议性止赎程序中被出售，反而因擅自闯入自家住宅而被捕。该事件揭示了乔治亚州现行法律在保护老年人免受所有权盗窃及其后果方面的严重不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Vines v. LaSalle Bank案为司法判例基础，结合乔治亚州现行止赎与房产所有权法律框架，对比伊利诺伊州的法律保护模式。
AI.method: 案例分析法与比较法研究，通过对Vines v. LaSalle Bank案的审查，分析乔治亚州法律的缺陷，并借鉴伊利诺伊州的法律模式提出改革建议。
AI.findings: 乔治亚州法律在房产所有权盗窃案件中无法可靠地保障老年人留在家中；伊利诺伊州已建立了成熟且可靠的法律模型，可有效解决此类问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为房产所有权盗窃领域的法律研究提供了乔治亚州与伊利诺伊州之间的比较法视角，填补了州际法律差异对老年人住房保障影响的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乔治亚州立法机构提供了可直接借鉴的伊利诺伊州立法模板，以制定保护老年人免受所有权盗窃影响的法律措施。

title: Exact Conditional Confidence Intervals for Cramér's V: Near-Nominal and Tight Where the Guaranteed Interval Is Wide and the Software Interval Does Not Cover

detail.title: Exact Conditional Confidence Intervals for Cramér's V: Near-Nominal and Tight Where the Guaranteed Interval Is Wide and the Software Interval Does Not Cover

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author develops and maintains open-source statistical software [NAME/URL] that implements methods related to this work. The author derives no financial benefit from this software. No other competing financial or personal interests are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a methodological and simulation study using computer-simulated data and publicly available example contingency tables. No human participants, patients, or individual-person data were involved, so ethics approval and informed consent are not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Cramér's V, the effect size reported beside almost every chi-square test, is almost never accompanied by a confidence interval, because the interval is a hard nuisance-parameter problem: infinitely many tables share one effect-size value. The two intervals an analyst can reach for are unsatisfactory. The projection of a joint confidence region onto the effect size is guaranteed for every table but wide, over-covering at essentially 1.000 on larger tables; the noncentral inversion the software prints, and the bootstrap, are narrow but do not cover (median coverage 0.31 on this study's grid). This paper supplies an interval that is both valid and informative. Conditioning on the observed margins makes the exact conditional distribution of the Pearson statistic under a non-null association computable with no asymptotics and no Monte Carlo; inverting it yields a near-nominal confidence interval for Cramér's V that is a third to a half the width of the projection, the advantage growing with table size. The one price, stated plainly, is a change of estimand to the effect size at the observed margins; the mid-p default undercovers small effects, where a conservative variant or the projection remains the fallback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Cramér's V效应量的有效且信息量充足的置信区间构建方法。通过以观测边际为条件，利用Pearson统计量的精确条件分布（无需渐近假设或蒙特卡洛模拟）进行反演，得到了接近名义覆盖率的置信区间，其宽度仅为投影法的三分之一到二分之一，且随表格规模增大优势更加明显。
AI.research_question: 如何为Cramér's V效应量构建一个既有效（覆盖概率正确）又信息量充足（区间较窄）的置信区间？
AI.motivation: Cramér's V几乎总是伴随卡方检验被报告，但几乎从不附带置信区间，因为这是一个困难的扰动参数问题：无限多个表格共享同一个效应量值。现有的两种方法均有缺陷：联合置信区域的投影虽然对所有表格有保证但过宽（大表格覆盖率接近1.000）；非中心反演法和自助法虽然较窄但不覆盖（中位覆盖率仅0.31）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精确条件分布理论；Cramér's V效应量；卡方检验
AI.method: 以观测边际为条件，使非零关联下Pearson统计量的精确条件分布可计算（无需渐近方法和蒙特卡洛模拟），通过反演该分布获得Cramér's V的近似名义置信区间。
AI.findings: 新方法得到的置信区间宽度为投影法的三分之一到一半，且优势随表格规模增大而增加；mid-p默认设置在效应量较小时会覆盖不足，此时保守变体或投影法仍是备选方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了Cramér's V置信区间这一长期存在的扰动参数难题，提供了一种同时兼顾有效性（覆盖率）和效率（区间宽度）的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据分析实践中Cramér's V效应量提供了可计算的、信息量更充足的置信区间，使研究者能够在报告卡方检验时可靠地附上效应量的不确定性度量。

title: The Priced Dimensions of Asymmetric Risk

detail.title: The Priced Dimensions of Asymmetric Risk
detail.abstract: Do the many measures of asymmetric risk identify one downside factor or several priced dimensions? We study compensation for asymmetric risk in U.S. equities, separating robust premia, distinct return variation, and priced dimensions. Five measure families organize around three recurring priced dimensions rather than a single downside factor. Multiple dimensions receive compensation across periods and portfolio constructions, although their relative pricing strength varies over time. The resulting three-factor benchmark is not jointly spanned by leading factor models. The dimensions also exhibit distinct predictive relations with aggregate conditions. The results distinguish new measures from new priced risks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国股票市场中非对称风险的多维定价问题，发现五个非对称风险度量族围绕着三个重复出现的定价维度组织，而非单一的下跌风险因子。这三个维度在不同时期和投资组合构建下均获得补偿，但其相对定价强度随时间变化，且构成的基准无法被主流因子模型解释。
AI.research_question: 众多的非对称风险度量究竟识别的是单一的下跌因子还是多个不同的定价维度？
AI.motivation: 已有文献提出了大量非对称风险度量，但尚不清楚这些度量反映的是同一个潜在风险因子还是多个独立的定价维度，这直接影响因子模型构建和风险定价理论的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非对称风险定价理论；因子定价模型；下跌风险（downside risk）理论
AI.method: 将五类非对称风险度量族进行系统比较，区分稳健溢价（robust premia）、独特的收益变异（distinct return variation）和定价维度（priced dimensions），通过跨时期和跨投资组合构建的实证分析来识别定价维度。
AI.findings: 五个非对称风险度量族围绕三个重复出现的定价维度组织而非单一下跌因子；多个维度在不同时期和组合构建下均获得风险补偿，但相对定价强度随时间变化；三因子基准无法被主流因子模型联合跨越；各维度与宏观经济条件具有不同的预测关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非对称风险并非单一维度而是多维定价结构，区分了"新的度量"与"新的定价风险"，纠正了将非对称风险视为单一因子的简化认知，为多因子定价理论提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产配置和风险管理提供了更精细的非对称风险分解框架，帮助投资者识别不同定价维度及其随时间变化的相对重要性，并与宏观经济条件建立预测关系以辅助投资决策。

title: The Uniform-Target Dilemma in Industrial Policy
affiliations: Renmin University of China - School of Finance and Renmin University of China - School of Finance

detail.title: The Uniform-Target Dilemma in Industrial Policy
detail.abstract: Industrial policy faces a uniform-target dilemma: a common target can coordinate upgrading for firms already close to it, yet encourage observable compliance rather than substantive investment among firms farther away. Using 2.85 million Chinese firm-years, we construct policy leap distance, the product-space distance between firms' existing products and municipal policy targets. Policy leap distance is negatively related to firm productivity, and this relationship is nonlinear: moderate distance is associated with higher productivity, but the effect turns negative as targets move beyond a moderate distance and intensifies sharply for the most distant targets. Because a majority of firm-years face targets beyond this turning point, the distortion affects most firms rather than a small tail. The distortion is organizational on both sides: firms raise reportable R&D and entertainment spending while patenting less, and municipal governments write vaguer, more proceduredependent policies. These distant targets are not a response to local conditions: they are transmitted top-down as provincial and central policy narratives diffuse, largely independent of local officials' characteristics. External oversight partially corrects the distortion: central inspection shocks reduce municipal policy distance and dampen the firm-side response to distant targets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于285万中国工业企业-年份观测数据，研究产业政策"统一目标困境"：共同目标能协调接近目标的企业升级，却促使距离目标较远的企业进行可观察的合规行为而非实质性投资。论文构建"政策跳跃距离"（企业现有产品与市政政策目标之间的产品空间距离），发现该距离与生产率呈非线性负相关——适度距离与较高生产率相关，但超过临界点后效应转为负面，且对最远距离企业影响急剧加剧。由于大多数企业面临超过临界点的目标，这种扭曲影响多数企业而非少数尾部。扭曲是组织性的双向行为：企业增加可报告的研发和娱乐支出但减少专利，地方政府制定更模糊、更程序化的政策。远端目标并非对地方条件的回应，而是自上而下由省级和中央政策叙事扩散传导。中央检查冲击能部分纠正扭曲。
AI.research_question: 产业政策中的统一目标是否会导致远离目标的企业产生合规性扭曲而非实质性升级投资？
AI.motivation: 产业政策面临"统一目标困境"：共同目标可以协调接近目标的企业升级，但可能促使距离目标较远的企业进行表面合规而非实质投资。现有研究缺乏对这一问题的大规模实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品空间理论、产业政策目标设定理论、组织合规理论
AI.method: 基于285万中国工业企业-年份数据，构建政策跳跃距离指标（产品空间距离），运用非线性回归分析检验距离与生产率的关系，并结合中央检查冲击进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1）政策跳跃距离与生产率负相关且呈非线性：适度距离与较高生产率相关，但超过临界点后效应转负；2）大多数企业面临超过临界点的目标，扭曲影响多数企业；3）扭曲是组织性的：企业增加报告性研发和娱乐支出但减少专利，政府制定更模糊的政策；4）远端目标自上而下扩散，并非响应地方条件；5）中央检查冲击能减少政策距离并削弱企业扭曲反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证检验"统一目标困境"理论，揭示产业政策目标距离与企业行为的非线性关系，为理解政策目标设定的激励扭曲提供新视角，区分了实质性投资与可观察合规行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产业政策制定提供启示：政策目标应匹配企业实际能力距离，过度超前的统一目标会导致普遍的合规性扭曲；中央监督机制可以有效纠正地方政策执行中的扭曲。

title: The Control Perimeter - AI Control, the Deployment Protocol, and the Institution No Evaluation Reaches

detail.title: The Control Perimeter - AI Control, the Deployment Protocol, and the Institution No Evaluation Reaches
detail.abstract: The AI control agenda accepts a premise most of alignment research resists: that safety may have to be secured without trusting the model. Rather than trying to make a system want the right things, control asks how to prevent a system that wants the wrong things from causing unacceptable harm, and answers with deployment protocols, monitoring, auditing, restricted affordances, trusted substitution, whose adequacy is estimated by a red-team procedure the agenda calls a control evaluation. This paper takes the agenda seriously and on its own terms. Its claim is not that control is mistaken. Its claim is that control has a boundary it has not drawn. A control evaluation is defined over a model, a protocol, and a fixed deployment context, all inside the developer's environment. It certifies a safety property of that arrangement. It does not evaluate the institution that adopts the model, becomes dependent on it, and thereby acquires the capacity to cause the very harms the protocol was meant to bound. I call the boundary within which a protocol's guarantee holds the control perimeter, and I argue that the perimeter stops at the developer's sandbox while the power the evaluation is meant to govern has already moved outside it. The paper reconstructs the agenda's core instruments and transposes each from the model to the deploying institution, showing that the transposed problem is real, unaddressed, and in most cases invisible to the methods control has built. It closes with the minimal design a control evaluation would need in order to reach the deployer: a monitored decision surface, a demonstrated fallback, an externally triggerable audit channel, and an assigned controller for the institution rather than the model. The argument is offered as an extension of the control program, not a rejection of it.

AI.tldr: 本文认为AI控制议程存在一个未划定的边界——"控制周界"止步于开发者的沙盒环境，而未涵盖实际采用模型并因此获得伤害能力的部署机构。论文将控制议程的核心工具从模型层面转置到部署机构层面，指出该转置问题是真实、未被处理且对现有控制方法不可见的，并提出四种能触及部署者的控制评估设计要素。
AI.research_question: AI控制评估的保障范围是否存在边界？控制议程是否未能评估采用模型并因此获得伤害能力的部署机构？
AI.motivation: 控制议程接受了一个多数对齐研究抵制的预设：安全性可能必须在不信任模型的情况下实现。然而，控制评估仅针对模型、协议和固定部署环境（全部在开发者环境内）进行认证，忽略了采用该模型的机构这一关键环节。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI控制议程（AI control agenda）及其核心概念——控制评估（control evaluation）、控制周界（control perimeter）
AI.method: 概念性论证/理论重构：重建控制议程的核心工具，并将每个工具从模型层转置到部署机构层，分析转置后的问题性质。
AI.findings: 控制周界止步于开发者沙盒，而控制评估本应治理的权力已经转移到沙盒之外；将控制工具转置到机构层面后发现，转置问题真实存在但未被处理，且对现有控制方法不可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"控制周界"概念，揭示了控制评估在开发者环境与部署机构之间的边界空缺，将控制议程从模型层面扩展到部署机构层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出控制评估触及部署者所需的最简设计：受监控的决策面、可演示的回退机制、外部可触发的审计通道，以及为机构而非模型指定的管控者。

title: Bias Against Mobile Capital: Evidence from U.S. Environmental Enforcement

detail.title: Bias Against Mobile Capital: Evidence from U.S. Environmental Enforcement
detail.abstract: Do governments discriminate against foreign-owned firms in enforcing regulations? Politicians may favor domestic-owned firms through relaxed enforcement. Yet foreign-owned firms can face discrimination even under politicians who are not protectionist and value stringent regulation: an information-driven bias by bureaucratic regulators. Pro-regulatory politicians task bureaucrats with enforcement, which requires detecting violations that are not perfectly observable. External ownership---foreign or domestic non-local---may signal less familiarity with local regulations and greater violation risk, especially where politicians have promoted stringent rules. Regulators therefore target externally owned firms for additional scrutiny, such as inspections. I examine U.S. environmental regulation, where states can adopt stricter standards and conduct most enforcement. I link administrative records of scrutiny and penalties to ownership data covering 2.4 million plants since 1989. Scrutiny rises after plants are taken over by foreign owners while remaining unchanged after in-state takeovers. This reaction reflects information-driven discrimination rather than protectionism. It extends to domestic out-of-state takeovers. It is concentrated in Democratic strongholds, where pro-regulatory politicians have promoted stringent state-specific regulations. Penalty decisions show no comparable ownership bias but favor campaign donors. Information-driven bias within the bureaucracy, not protectionism, drives discrimination against foreign investors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，政府在外资企业监管执法中存在信息驱动的歧视而非保护主义。在赞成严格监管的政治家管辖下，官僚监管者因信息不对称（外资企业可能不熟悉当地法规）而对外资企业进行更多审查（如检查），但对罚款决定无显著所有权偏见，反而偏向政治捐赠者。
AI.research_question: 政府是否在法规执行中歧视外资企业？这种歧视是源于保护主义还是官僚机构中的信息驱动偏差？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常认为政治家可能通过放松执法来偏袒国内企业（保护主义），但忽略了即使在不持保护主义立场且重视严格监管的政治家领导下，外资企业仍可能面临歧视——这种歧视源于官僚监管者基于信息的推断性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息驱动偏见理论：外资/外部所有权可能传递出对当地法规不熟悉的信号，暗示更高的违规风险，因此监管者会优先对外资企业进行额外审查。这一机制区别于保护主义解释。
AI.method: 利用美国环境监管数据，将审查和处罚的行政记录与涵盖1989年以来240万家工厂的所有权数据关联，采用外国收购前后的对比分析（外国收购后审查增加，而州内收购后不变），并结合政治环境（民主党主导州）和处罚决定进行差异检验。
AI.findings: 1. 外国所有者收购后，工厂审查增加，但州内收购无此变化；2. 该反应是信息驱动而非保护主义；3. 同样适用于国内跨州收购；4. 集中在民主党主导州（赞成严格监管的地区）；5. 处罚决定无明显的所有权偏见，但偏向竞选捐赠者。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了官僚机构中"信息驱动偏见"这一新的歧视机制，区别于传统的保护主义解释，丰富了关于外资歧视来源的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示外资企业在监管执法中面临系统性额外审查的政策后果，提示政策制定者关注官僚执行层面的隐性歧视，以及政治捐赠对处罚公平性的潜在影响。

title: Engagement Without Endorsement: The Limits of Influencer Prosocial Behavior
affiliations: Boston College - Department of Marketing, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business and Toronto Metropolitan University

detail.title: Engagement Without Endorsement: The Limits of Influencer Prosocial Behavior
detail.abstract: Influencers increasingly post about their prosocial acts, including monetary donations, in-kind support, and symbolic gestures. Whether such displays of virtue are rewarded, and how they shape audience engagement, remain unclear. Using a large-scale dataset from a major Chinese social media platform, the authors find that prosocial posts increase likes per view but decrease shares per view, with the share penalty concentrated among highly commercial influencers. Likes and shares occupy distinct points on an engagement spectrum: likes convey light-touch approval, whereas shares redistribute the content into audiences' own networks under their name. Prosocial posts may therefore generate engagement without endorsement. The authors complement the field study with a controlled experiment. By randomly varying an influencer's commercial track record, the experiment shows how commercialization can prevent prosocial content from translating into endorsement and identifies reduced source credibility as the underlying mechanism. Because likes vastly outnumber shares, aggregate engagement can make such posts appear successful while masking an erosion of endorsement. Together, these findings reveal a limit to virtue as a reputational corrective: doing good does not undo the reputational cost of doing well commercially.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国大型社交媒体平台的大规模数据和受控实验，发现网红的亲社会行为帖子（如捐款、实物支持、象征性姿态）能增加点赞率但降低分享率，且分享率的下降主要集中在高度商业化的网红身上。原因在于点赞和分享处于不同的参与度谱系：点赞代表轻量级认可，而分享则意味着将内容重新分发到自身社交网络。亲社会帖子可能带来参与度却无法获得真正的背书，商业化损伤了来源可信度是潜在机制。
AI.research_question: 网红的亲社会行为展示（如捐款、实物支持、象征性姿态）是否会得到受众回报？这些展示如何塑造受众参与度（点赞vs分享）？
AI.motivation: 网红越来越多地发布亲社会行为内容，但其效果尚不清楚。现有文献缺乏对亲社会展示如何影响不同类型受众参与（点赞与分享）的系统研究，尤其是商业化背景下的作用。作者旨在揭示"美德展示"在声誉修复方面的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亲社会行为理论、来源可信度理论（source credibility）、参与度谱系概念（点赞vs分享区分）、声誉修复理论
AI.method: 混合方法：1）大规模实地数据研究——使用中国主要社交媒体平台的数据，分析亲社会帖子对点赞率和分享率的影响；2）受控实验——随机操作网红的商业化历史记录，检验商业化如何阻止亲社会内容转化为背书，并验证来源可信度降低的机制。
AI.findings: 1）亲社会帖子增加每次浏览的点赞数，但降低每次浏览的分享数；2）分享惩罚集中在高度商业化的网红中；3）实验证实商业化会阻止亲社会内容转化为受众背书，机制是来源可信度降低；4）由于点赞数量远多于分享，总参与度指标可能掩盖了背书侵蚀的问题，使亲社会帖子看似成功实则不然。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）区分了点赞与分享作为不同参与度层次的概念，提出二者在受众心理和传播意义上存在本质差异；2）揭示了"美德作为声誉修复工具"的边界条件——做好事并不能抵消商业化带来的声誉成本；3）识别出来源可信度作为亲社会内容向背书转化的关键机制；4）丰富了亲社会行为与商业化的交互作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）对网红和管理者：提示亲社会内容可能只带来表面参与（点赞）而非真实背书（分享），需警惕聚合参与指标的误导性；2）对平台设计者：揭示不同参与行为（点赞vs分享）具有不同信号价值，平台指标设计应加以区分；3）对营销实践者：高度商业化的网红应意识到亲社会内容无法有效修复声誉，商业化战略需谨慎权衡。

title: Building High-Performance Educational Organisations Through Effective Leadership
affiliations: Oxford Academy and George Mason University

detail.title: Building High-Performance Educational Organisations Through Effective Leadership
detail.abstract:
Educational organisations are expected to deliver learning quality, equity, resilience, and continuous improvement under resource pressure and social change. Leadership is frequently presented as the mechanism that converts policy and resources into organisational performance, yet the relationship is indirect and context-sensitive. This thesis examines how effective leadership can contribute to high-performance educational organisations, using Jordan as the primary setting, the United Kingdom as an international comparator, and selected Middle Eastern systems as regional benchmarks. A pragmatic comparative case-study design integrates published OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2022 indicators, official policy documents, and a structured synthesis of leadership literature. The evidence covers 7,799 students in 260 schools in Jordan and 12,972 students in 451 schools in the United Kingdom. Descriptive analysis compares achievement, minimum proficiency, school autonomy, staffing constraints, resources, and continuity-of-learning indicators. It does not attribute national score differences causally to leadership.

Jordan shows a substantial performance and proficiency gap relative to the United Kingdom, accompanied by large differences in selected school decision rights. Only 5% of students in Jordan attended schools where principals had the main responsibility for hiring teachers and 3% attended schools where teachers had the main responsibility for choosing learning materials; corresponding United Kingdom figures were 81% and 89%. Staffing shortages affected both systems, but exposure to inadequate or poorly qualified staff was markedly higher in Jordan. The findings indicate that high performance cannot be reduced to one leadership style or to autonomy alone. It requires an aligned architecture combining strategic direction, instructional leadership, professional capability, distributed participation, bounded autonomy, reciprocal accountability, evidence-informed improvement, and resilience. The thesis proposes a six-domain High-Performance Educational Leadership and Organisation framework and a phased implementation roadmap. Its principal contribution is a context-sensitive model that treats leadership as an organisational capability rather than a heroic individual trait.

AI.tldr: 本研究以约旦为主要案例、英国为国际比较对象、中东部分国家为区域参照，采用务实比较案例设计，整合PISA 2022数据、政策文件和文献综述，探讨有效领导力如何促进高绩效教育组织。研究提出一个六维度的"高绩效教育领导力与组织框架"及分阶段实施路线图，强调领导力是一种组织能力而非英雄式个人特质。
AI.research_question: 有效领导力如何促进高绩效教育组织的形成？领导力与组织绩效之间的间接且情境敏感的关系在约旦、英国和中东系统中如何体现？
AI.motivation: 教育组织在资源压力和社会变革下需同时实现学习质量、公平、韧性和持续改进，而领导力被视为将政策与资源转化为组织绩效的机制，但这一关系是间接且依赖情境的，需要深入理解其作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力与组织绩效关系理论、学校自治与决策权理论、情境敏感的教育领导力理论、组织能力理论（区别于英雄式个体特质）
AI.method: 务实的比较案例研究设计，整合OECD PISA 2022指标数据、官方政策文件及领导力文献的结构化综述；约旦样本含260所学校7,799名学生，英国样本含451所学校12,972名学生；采用描述性分析比较学业成就、最低熟练度、学校自治、人员约束、资源和学习连续性等指标
AI.findings: 约旦在学业表现和熟练度方面与英国存在显著差距，学校决策权差异巨大（约旦仅5%学生就读于校长主导教师招聘的学校，3%就读于教师主导教材选择的学校，而英国相应为81%和89%）；人员短缺影响两国，但约旦学生更多暴露于不合格或资历不足的教师；高绩效不能简化为单一领导风格或自治权，需要涉及战略方向、教学领导力、专业能力、分布式参与、有界自治、互惠问责、循证改进和韧性等多维度的协同架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个情境敏感的高绩效教育领导力与组织模型，将领导力重新概念化为组织能力而非英雄式个人特质，为理解领导力与教育绩效之间的间接关系提供了综合理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六维度"高绩效教育领导力与组织框架"和分阶段实施路线图，为约旦及类似情境的教育系统改革提供可操作的实践指导。

title: Powering Intelligence - A 50-State Analysis of Electricity Economics, Tax Incentives and Regulatory Risk for AI Data Center Investment

detail.title: Powering Intelligence - A 50-State Analysis of Electricity Economics, Tax Incentives and Regulatory Risk for AI Data Center Investment
detail.abstract:
Electricity has quietly become the single largest constraint on the build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure in the United States. Industry load-growth forecasts now point to data centers consuming a high-single-digit share of total U.S. electricity by the end of the decade, up from roughly 4% only a few years ago [1], and the effect is already visible in the generation mix: coal-fired generation, which had been in structural decline for over a decade, rose approximately 13% in 2025 as grid operators delayed retirements under emergency federal orders to keep pace with demand [2]. For an industry that has spent three years fixated on GPU allocation, the binding constraint has shifted decisively to power — interconnection queues, transmission capacity, and the price of a kilowatt-hour now weigh as heavily on site-selection decisions as chip supply.

This report does three things a conventional cost comparison does not. First, it benchmarks electricity cost and generation mix across all 50 states and the District of Columbia using U.S. Energy Information Administration (“EIA”) data. Second, it introduces the AI Power Competitiveness Index (“PCI”), a weighted, reproducible scoring model that combines electricity cost, state tax competitiveness, incentive generosity, and — critically — regulatory and litigation risk, since the cheapest state on paper is not necessarily the most investable state in practice. Third, it tracks the fast-moving legal and regulatory record as of 11 August 2026, because the incentive and rate landscape for large loads has changed more in the last twelve months than in the prior decade combined.

On a purely economic basis — electricity price, tax competitiveness, incentive depth, and regulatory stability weighted together — our model ranks Texas, New Mexico, Tennessee, Iowa, and Wyoming as the five most competitive states for new AI data-center capacity in 2026 (Section 4). Notably, Virginia — home to the world's largest concentration of data centers — and Illinois fall toward the bottom of the risk-adjusted ranking despite (or in Virginia's case, partly because of) their scale, illustrating that first-mover advantage and incumbent infrastructure are not the same thing as forward risk-adjusted competitiveness.

This is a fast-moving fact pattern. Governor Abbott ordered Texas regulators to pause approval of all new data-center grid connections pending an audit as recently as 3 August 2026 [7] — eight days before this report's issue date — while the Louisiana Public Service Commission was still resolving discovery disputes over a $21 billion Entergy/Meta generation build-out as of 4 August 2026 [8]. We have flagged every item in this report by its “as of” date and recommend the reader treat Sections 6 and 7 as a living tracker rather than a static record.

AI.tldr: 本报告基于EIA数据对美国50个州及哥伦比亚特区的电力成本和发电结构进行基准比较，提出了AI电力竞争力指数（PCI），综合电力成本、税收竞争力、激励政策和监管诉讼风险等维度进行加权评分，并对截至2026年8月11日的法律监管动态进行了追踪。
AI.research_question: 在电力成为美国AI基础设施建设的最大约束的背景下，哪些州对新建AI数据中心最具竞争力？如何构建一个可复现的综合评估模型来衡量各州的AI电力竞争力？
AI.motivation: 电力已成为制约美国AI基础设施建设的最关键瓶颈——数据中心用电占比将从几年前约4%上升至未来高个位数百分比，2025年煤电在结构性衰退十余年后因电网应急调度而回升13%。传统成本比较无法全面评估各州竞争力，需要一个涵盖经济、政策和监管风险的综合指数。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI电力竞争力指数（PCI）——一个加权可复现的评分模型，综合考量电力成本、州税收竞争力、激励政策力度以及监管和诉讼风险四个维度。
AI.method: 使用美国能源信息署（EIA）数据对全美50个州及DC进行电力成本和发电结构基准比较；构建AI电力竞争力指数（PCI）加权评分模型；追踪截至2026年8月11日的法律监管动态记录。
AI.findings: 按经济维度加权排名，德克萨斯、新墨西哥、田纳西、爱荷华和怀俄明是2026年AI数据中心新建产能最具竞争力的五个州。值得注意的是，拥有全球最大数据中心集群的弗吉尼亚州和伊利诺伊州在风险调整后的排名中垫底，说明先发优势和现有基础设施并不等同于前瞻性的风险调整后竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出将监管和诉讼风险纳入州级AI电力竞争力评估的框架，超越了单纯的经济成本比较；揭示了先发优势（incumbent infrastructure）与风险调整后竞争力之间的非等价关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI数据中心选址决策提供可复现的跨州比较工具；提供实时更新的法律监管追踪器（第6、7节），帮助投资者和产业界把握快速变化的激励与电价政策环境；识别出监管不确定性（如德州暂停审批、路易斯安那州诉讼）对投资决策的实质影响。

title: Housing Access, Affordability, and Financialization in Italy: Evidence of Housing Market Exclusion from the Bank of Italy's Survey on Household Income and Wealth

detail.title: Housing Access, Affordability, and Financialization in Italy: Evidence of Housing Market Exclusion from the Bank of Italy's Survey on Household Income and Wealth
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the Italian housing market with the aim of analyzing tenure distribution and assessing the efficiency of the market. Using microdata provided by the Bank of Italy from the Survey on Household Income and Wealth, the study examines whether tenure distribution differs across regions and household types. While acknowledging that tenure outcomes are influenced by several determinants, the primary objective is to understand how the housing market is structured and stratified. The Italian housing market can be broadly described in terms of two main groups: homeowners and tenants. However, the analysis also identifies additional relevant categories, such as multiowners (families who possess more than one property) and landlords (families who rent at least one property they own). The presence and intensity of these groups provide important insights into the functioning and efficiency of the housing market. Furthermore, housing dynamics cannot be separated from financial market processes. This paper explores the extent to which financial mechanisms are embedded in the housing market, arguing that a higher degree of integration corresponds to a greater level of financialization, defined as the increasing influence of investment and speculative motives over fundamental housing needs. In this context, speculative dynamics are driven by the expected returns associated with rental income. These elements allow for the identification of two interconnected segments: the homeownership sector and the rental sector. Their interaction creates a situation in which property owners can extract additional income through the rental market, while tenants face limited bargaining power. From this perspective, it becomes difficult to interpret renting as a voluntary choice. On the contrary, the evidence presented in this study suggests that tenancy is largely the result of exclusionary mechanisms within the housing market. Empirically, the analysis is based on logistic and linear regression models, predictive probabilities and housing burden and financialization indicators, in order to capture both distributional patterns and the role of financial factors in shaping the Italian housing system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利央行家庭收入和财富调查的微观数据，研究意大利住房市场的产权分布与市场效率，重点分析房主、租户、多房产所有者及房东等不同群体，并探讨住房市场与金融市场融合所导致的金融化现象，以及租赁市场中的排斥性机制。
AI.research_question: 意大利住房市场的产权分布在不同地区和家庭类型间是否存在差异？住房市场的结构与分层如何运作？金融机制在住房市场中的嵌入程度如何影响金融化水平？
AI.motivation: 意大利住房市场存在明显的产权分层，租户面临有限议价能力，租赁可能并非自愿选择而是市场排斥的结果。作者旨在揭示住房市场中的排斥性机制及金融化对住房体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融化理论（认为金融市场与住房市场融合程度越高，投资和投机动机越强于基本住房需求）；排斥性机制视角（租赁被解释为市场排斥的结果而非自愿选择）。
AI.method: 基于意大利央行"家庭收入和财富调查"微观数据，运用Logistic回归和线性回归模型，结合预测概率、住房负担指标和金融化指标进行分析。
AI.findings: 意大利住房市场可分为业主和租户两大群体，并存在多房产所有者和房东等额外类别；产权分布存在地区差异；住房市场与金融市场的融合推动了金融化进程，投机动机受到租金预期收益驱动；房产所有者可通过租赁市场获取额外收入，而租户面临有限的议价能力；租赁在很大程度上是市场排斥性机制的结果而非自愿选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融化理论应用于意大利住房市场分析，将"租赁非自愿性"概念化，论证产权分层与金融化之间的内在联系，丰富了住房分层与金融化交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利住房政策制定提供实证依据，揭示住房市场中的排斥性机制和金融化趋势，有助于政策制定者关注租户权益保护和住房市场公平性问题。

title: Pro-Metrix Architecture: Formulation of an Original Framework Based on the Synthesis of Productivity Tools, Techniques, and Methods (TTM) in Corporate or Industrial Productivity Transformation

detail.title: Pro-Metrix Architecture: Formulation of an Original Framework Based on the Synthesis of Productivity Tools, Techniques, and Methods (TTM) in Corporate or Industrial Productivity Transformation
detail.abstract: This study formulates PRO-METRIX (Productivity Measurement & Transformation Matrix), an original framework that synthesizes a catalog of 64 productivity Tools, Techniques, and Methods (TTM)—previously compiled by the author in “The Application of TTM for Productivity Improvement” (Panjaitan, 2026a) — into a single two-axis matrix architecture: the 4P framework (People, Process, Product, Policy) and the Planning-Executing-Sustaining cycle (APO-PS 101:2023). This study specifically positions PRO-METRIX not as a competitor, but as a Tier-2 (deep-dive) instrument activated after the Tier-1 (screening)—exemplified by the PROFITO Framework v1.0 from the Special Region of Yogyakarta’s Department of Manpower and Transmigration—to identify high-risk companies, those in critical sectors, or those exhibiting significant anomalies. Four core modules were formulated as functional counterparts to the four PROFITO outputs: the Transformation Synergy Index (IST, derived from its Indonesian name “Indeks Sinergi Transformasi”), which integrates the Green Risk-Adjusted Productivity Index (GRAPI-N) as an assessment engine for physical resource efficiency; the Dynamic 4P Maturity Quadrant, which replaces the 1–5 ladder model with a multidimensional radar visualization; the Root Cause Navigation System (SNAM, derived from its Indonesian name Sistem Navigasi Akar Masalah), which automatically maps gaps to specific TTM tools; and the Execution & Financial Validation Blueprint, which integrates real-world technical-financial feasibility studies, exemplified through simulations of industrial wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) and building HVAC/AC energy efficiency audits. This study concludes that a two-tier architecture (Tier-1 screening – Tier-2 deep-dive) provides a stronger methodological foundation that is more readily accepted both academically and institutionally compared to a head-to-head competition model, while also providing a concrete pathway to guide a company’s green business transformation within the policy horizons of regional and national productivity initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了PRO-METRIX框架，将64种生产力工具、技术和方法（TTM）整合为双轴矩阵架构（4P框架+规划-执行-维持周期），作为Tier-2深度分析工具，配合Tier-1筛选工具（PROFITO框架v1.0）形成两级架构，用于识别高风险企业并指导其绿色业务转型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统的框架（PRO-METRIX），将多样化的生产力工具整合为双轴矩阵架构，并与现有的Tier-1筛选工具（PROFITO框架）协同工作，以指导和评估企业的绿色业务转型？
AI.motivation: 现有的生产力评估工具（如PROFITO框架v1.0）主要作为筛选工具，缺乏深度分析能力。作者希望通过构建一个Tier-2深度分析框架，弥补现有工具在识别高风险企业、关键行业或显著异常方面的不足，同时提供更全面、更系统的生产力提升路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 4P框架（People, Process, Product, Policy）；Planning-Executing-Sustaining周期（APO-PS 101:2023）；PROFITO框架v1.0（Tier-1筛选）；PRO-METRIX两级架构理论
AI.method: 框架构建与模块化设计研究。具体包括：（1）整合64种TTM工具为双轴矩阵架构；（2）设计四个核心模块：IST（整合GRAPI-N绿色风险调整生产力指数）、Dynamic 4P Maturity Quadrant（多维雷达可视化）、SNAM（根因导航系统，自动映射差距到具体TTM工具）、Execution & Financial Validation Blueprint（通过工业污水处理厂和建筑HVAC/AC能效审计模拟进行验证）
AI.findings: 两级架构（Tier-1筛选–Tier-2深度分析）比直接竞争模型更具方法论优势，更容易在学术和机构层面被接受；该架构为企业在区域和国家生产力倡议的政策范围内实现绿色业务转型提供了具体路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PRO-METRIX原创框架，将64种TTM工具系统化为双轴矩阵架构；建立了Tier-1/Tier-2两级分析范式，弥补了单一筛选工具的不足；构建了四个功能模块（IST、Dynamic 4P Maturity Quadrant、SNAM、Execution & Financial Validation Blueprint）作为PROFITO输出的功能对应物，丰富了生产力评估的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和机构提供了识别高风险企业和关键行业的实用工具；通过工业污水处理厂和HVAC能效审计的模拟案例，展示了框架在技术-财务可行性评估中的实际应用价值；为企业绿色转型提供了从筛选到深度分析再到执行验证的完整路径。

title: After American Primacy -The End of American "Exceptionalism" Iran, The Yuan and the Transfer of Global Power Special Case Study: Canada's Role, A Swot Analysis and it’s Best Positioning to Adapt
affiliations: Szymon Zephan Capital (SZC Group)

detail.title: After American Primacy -The End of American "Exceptionalism" Iran, The Yuan and the Transfer of Global Power Special Case Study: Canada's Role, A Swot Analysis and it’s Best Positioning to Adapt
detail.abstract: American primacy rested on more than the size of the United States economy or the depth of the Treasury market. It joined five promises into a single operating system: the United States would protect critical sea lanes, provide a vast market, police a dollar-centred financial network, supply liquid safe assets, and impose costs on states that challenged the order. The 2026 Iran war did not instantly replace the dollar. It did something more consequential at the level of expectations: it separated those promises. Washington remained militarily formidable, yet it did not promptly restore normal passage through the Strait of Hormuz; its regional bases proved vulnerable; high-end munitions were consumed at rates that affected wider readiness; and negotiations increasingly concerned the terms of Iranian influence over the very chokepoint the campaign was meant to secure. This report argues that the end of American "exceptionalism" should be understood as the end of automaticity. Other states no longer assume that U.S. protection will be decisive, that access to U.S. markets will remain unconditional, that financial sanctions will compel rather than merely punish, or that alignment with Washington will be costless. The immediate result is not a clean succession from dollar to yuan. It is a layered transfer of power: trade routes and settlement practices change first; credit, hedging and custody follow; reserve portfolios adjust last. The yuan's central weakness-limited convertibility and a thinner safe-asset complex-remains real. Its strategic advantage is different: China can combine market access, manufacturing scale, energy demand, bilateral finance and alternative settlement with the demonstrated capacity of partner states to resist U.S. coercion. Canada is the report's special case because it is simultaneously the United States' closest economic partner, a beneficiary of the old order, a G7 power with resources desired by every major bloc, and a middle power newly compelled to hedge. Canada's best position is neither reflexive anti-Americanism nor passive continental dependence. It is allied strategic autonomy: preserve the irreplaceable benefits of North American integration while building European defence-industrial depth, Indo-Pacific and Gulf market options, tidewater energy and critical-mineral corridors, financial-contingency capacity, and a diplomatic role capable of working across rival systems.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国霸权的终结并非美元被取代，而是"自动性"的终结——各国不再假定美国保护、市场准入和金融制裁将自动生效。权力转移呈现分层特征：贸易路线先行、信用和托管跟进、储备组合最后调整。加拿大作为特殊案例，应寻求"同盟战略自主"。
AI.research_question: 美国霸权（尤其是美元体系）在面临挑战时的终结方式是什么？加拿大应如何在大国竞争格局中定位自身？
AI.motivation: 2026年伊朗战争打破了美国"五重承诺"体系的自动性，各国对美国的预期发生变化。理解这一权力转移的性质（非简单的美元替代，而是分层转移）对政策制定至关重要，尤其是对加拿大这类深度依赖美国又需对冲的中等强国。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国霸权的"操作系统"理论——将霸权视为保护海路、提供市场、监管金融网络、供给安全资产和施加惩罚五个承诺的整合体；预期与可信度理论；权力转移的分层理论（贸易→信用→储备）。
AI.method: 政策分析/战略报告，基于2026年伊朗战争的地缘政治事件推演，结合国际政治经济学框架进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 美元并未被人民币取代，但美国承诺的"自动性"已终结；2) 权力转移呈分层特征：贸易结算先行变化，信用/对冲/托管随后，储备组合最后调整；3) 人民币虽有可兑换性和安全资产不足的弱点，但中国可通过市场准入、制造业规模、能源需求、双边金融和替代结算的组合发挥战略优势；4) 加拿大作为G7中等强国应追求"同盟战略自主"，而非极端反美或被动依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"自动性终结"概念重新定义美国例外主义的终结，将霸权终结从"货币替代"重新概念化为"预期体系"的瓦解；提出权力转移的分层模型（trade→credit→reserves），丰富国际货币权力转移理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大的战略定位提供路径建议：保持北美一体化的同时，发展欧洲国防工业深度、印太和海湾市场选项、潮汐能源和关键矿产走廊、金融应急能力以及跨体系外交角色。对理解美元体系演变和中国战略优势提供政策参考。

title: Source Sovereignty: A Continental Framework for Taxing Value Where It Is Created in Africa

detail.title: Source Sovereignty: A Continental Framework for Taxing Value Where It Is Created in Africa
detail.abstract:
In this paper, I develop and quantify the Source Sovereignty Framework (SSF), which presents a continental policy architecture enabling African states to act as a coordinated bloc of 54 jurisdictions. This framework proposes that these states tax cross-border income precisely at the point of generation. This taxation is envisioned to be collected through gross-basis withholding mechanisms integrated within African payment systems, thereby rendering it independent of the consent, ratification, or administrative cooperation of capital-exporting states.

The SSF comprises five integral components: a core source-taxation principle; a four-layer legal architecture anchored in an African Union convention that binds African states to one another; a moderate gross-basis rate structure; a coordinated four-phase transition away from the existing bilateral treaty network; and an anti-defection mechanism aimed at preventing intra-African arbitrage.

Drawing on peer-reviewed literature concerning profit shifting, tax treaties, investment incentives, and digital taxation, I argue that the predominant objections to unilateral assertiveness by African nations, namely concerns regarding investor flight, double taxation, retaliation, and administrative incapacity, are either unsupported by empirical evidence or are adequately addressed by the design of the framework itself. Moreover, the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation, while diplomatically significant, cannot effectively substitute for a collection architecture that is deemed necessary to remain under African control.

Using a transparent scenario model, I predict that a fully phased-in SSF could yield incremental revenue of approximately US$20 billion annually by 2030 (US$11–33 billion) and around US$36 billion annually by 2035 (US$19–58 billion). Furthermore, I estimate that the cumulative financial gains over the period from 2028 to 2035 could reach approximately US$184 billion under central assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并量化了"来源主权框架"（SSF），该框架建立了一套大陆性政策架构，使非洲54个司法管辖区能够作为协调一致的集团行动。该框架主张非洲国家在跨境收入的产生点进行征税，通过非洲支付系统内的预提机制征收，独立于资本输出国的同意或合作。模型预测全面实施后，到2030年每年可增加约200亿美元收入，到2035年每年约360亿美元。
AI.research_question: 非洲国家如何通过协调一致的大陆级税收政策架构，在跨境收入来源地有效征税，并量化这一框架的潜在财政收入影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲国家长期面临税基侵蚀和利润转移问题，但传统的双边税收条约网络和国际税收合作框架（如UN框架公约）无法有效解决这一问题。现有的主要反对意见（投资者逃离、双重征税、报复、行政能力不足）需要被检验，因此有必要设计并评估一个由非洲自主控制的大陆级税收架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源主权框架（SSF）；来源地征税原则；利润转移与税基侵蚀文献；税收条约理论；投资激励理论；数字税收理论
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析与量化建模相结合的方法。基于同行评审文献的系统梳理，构建SSF框架的理论论证；并使用透明的场景模型（scenario model）预测SSF在不同时间节点（2030、2035年）的增量财政收入以及2028-2035年的累计收益。
AI.findings: 主要反对非洲单边征税主张的论据（投资者逃离、双重征税、报复、行政能力不足）要么缺乏实证支持，要么可由SSF框架设计本身解决。UN国际税收合作框架公约虽然在外交上具有重要意义，但无法替代非洲自主控制的征收架构。SSF全面实施后，到2030年每年可带来约200亿美元增量收入（区间110-330亿美元），到2035年每年约360亿美元（区间190-580亿美元）；2028-2035年累计财政收益在中心假设下约达1840亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"来源主权框架"（SSF）这一全新的理论架构，将非洲54个司法管辖区整合为一个协调税收集团；系统性地反驳了国际上对非洲单边税收主张的四大反对论点；论证了UN框架公约的局限性，即外交重要性与有效征收效力的分离。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲政策制定者提供了可操作的五组件税收架构设计（核心来源税原则、四层法律架构、适度税率结构、四阶段过渡、反叛逃机制）；提供了透明的量化预测模型，给出了具体财政收益估算，为非洲国家协调税收改革提供了决策依据。

title: Xhdfe: Fast High-Dimensional Fixed-Effects Estimation in Stata
affiliations: University of Minho and University of Minho - Economic Policies Research Unit (NIPE)

detail.title: Xhdfe: Fast High-Dimensional Fixed-Effects Estimation in Stata
detail.abstract: xhdfe is a Stata command for linear regression with high-dimensional fixed effects. It targets the same partialled-out least-squares estimator as reghdfe on the overlapping specifications studied here, while moving the main absorption workload into a compiled C++ backend with multithreaded CPU execution and optional NVIDIA CUDA acceleration. The command preserves a Stata e-class interface while supporting multiple absorbed fixed effects, clustered and robust standard errors, heterogeneous slopes in the tested specifications, backend choices, saved fixed effects, residuals, fitted values, and stored results. We validate xhdfe on two large wage regressions using Portuguese matched employer-employee data. The command reproduces reghdfe coefficients and standard errors within tight numerical tolerances and delivers speedups above 100-fold with CPU execution and 200-fold with CUDA acceleration in the fastest configurations. Compared with alternative high-dimensional fixed-effects implementations, xhdfe records the shortest runtimes among the implementations and configurations reported here. The development history also provides a case study of AI-assisted software development. Agentic tools supported coding and review, while conventional numerical tests and reproducible benchmarks assessed the resulting changes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍xhdfe——一个用于高维固定效应线性回归的Stata命令，通过C++后端和多线程/GPU加速实现比reghdfe快100倍以上的性能提升，同时保持数值精度和Stata e-class接口兼容性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个在Stata环境中实现高维固定效应线性回归的高性能命令，既保持数值精度和接口兼容性，又能显著提升计算速度？
AI.motivation: 现有Stata命令（如reghdfe）在处理高维固定效应回归时计算效率低下，难以满足大规模面板数据（如葡萄牙雇主-雇员匹配数据）的分析需求。同时，开发过程也探索了AI辅助软件开发的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分消除最小二乘估计（partialled-out least-squares estimator）、高维固定效应回归理论
AI.method: 开发xhdfe Stata命令，核心吸收计算逻辑用C++实现，支持多线程CPU和NVIDIA CUDA GPU加速；使用葡萄牙大规模雇主-雇员匹配工资数据验证；与reghdfe和其他高维固定效应实现进行数值精度和运行时间对比。
AI.findings: xhdfe在测试配置中与reghdfe系数和标准误在严格数值容差内一致；CPU执行速度提升超过100倍，CUDA加速配置下提升超过200倍；在所有比较的实现中运行时间最短；开发过程展示了AI辅助开发的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了高维固定效应回归的高性能计算方法论，验证了C++后端+GPU加速在计量经济学软件实现中的可行性和有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Stata用户提供了可用的高性能高维固定效应回归命令xhdfe；展示了AI辅助软件开发在计量经济学工具开发中的应用案例；为大规模面板数据分析提供了显著的计算效率提升方案。

title: Default Rules and Independent Reporting in Covert Evidence Acquisition
affiliations: Berlin School of Economics

detail.title: Default Rules and Independent Reporting in Covert Evidence Acquisition
detail.abstract: Evidence rules shape what missing evidence reveals and whether it is produced. After a private signal, a sender may acquire evidence and conceal bad news. I rank voluntary certification, deny-by-default, and independent acquisition reporting by the receiver's guarantee, her worst equilibrium payoff. Under either Bayesian response regime, a sender-best equilibrium minimizes acquisition and attains the guarantee. In the binary benchmark, deny-by-default beats a Bayesian response exactly when it induces more acquisition. The ranking can change nonmonotonically with cost. For atomless posterior distributions supported arbitrarily close to certainty, high costs make the default induce more acquisition yet lower the guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究证据规则如何影响缺失证据所揭示的信息以及证据是否会被产生。在发送者收到私人信号后，可能获取证据并隐藏坏消息。作者比较了自愿认证、默认拒绝和独立获取报告三种制度下接收者的最坏均衡收益（保证值）。研究发现，在贝叶斯响应制度下，发送者最优均衡最小化证据获取并达到保证值；在二元基准情形中，默认拒绝恰好在其诱导更多证据获取时优于贝叶斯响应；排序可能随成本非单调变化。
AI.research_question: 不同证据规则（自愿认证、默认拒绝、独立获取报告）如何影响发送者的证据获取行为以及接收者的最坏均衡收益（保证值）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献尚未系统比较不同证据规则下，缺失证据的信息含量及其对接收者福利的影响，特别是考虑证据获取成本后规则排序的非单调性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的信号博弈与贝叶斯响应均衡框架，涉及证据获取（acquisition）与证据隐瞒（concealment）的内生决策。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析：构建发送者-接收者信号博弈模型，比较三种证据规则下的均衡，并利用保证值（receiver's guarantee，即最坏均衡收益）作为排序标准。
AI.findings: （1）在贝叶斯响应制度下，发送者最优均衡最小化证据获取并达到保证值；（2）在二元基准情形中，默认拒绝比贝叶斯响应更优，当且仅当其诱导更多证据获取；（3）规则排名可能随成本非单调变化；（4）对于任意接近确定性的原子后验分布，高成本使默认规则诱导更多获取但降低保证值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为证据规则设计提供了统一的理论比较框架，揭示了证据获取内生化对缺失证据信息含量的影响，并发现了规则排序随成本非单调变化的新现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律和监管中的证据规则设计（如举证责任分配）提供了理论指导，特别是关于在何种成本条件下应选择不同的证据制度以最大化接收者（如法庭、监管机构）的保障。

detail.title: Sustainable Development Practices in the Ancient Hindu Community

detail.abstract: This article examines the concept of sustainable development in the ancient Hindu community through a textual and analytical lens, showing how Sanskrit scriptures, especially Kauilya's Arthastra, connect governance, ethics, economy, law, and social order. It identifies how the tradition frames statecraft as a practical science aimed at protecting welfare, maintaining justice, and ensuring stability through disciplined administration, legal regulation, and strategic oversight. Drawing on a qualitative and analytical approach with textual interpretation and a structured review of recent scholarship, the article highlights continuities between ancient normative ideas and contemporary concerns about sustainable and ethical governance. The discussion also shows that the tradition is not limited to economics alone, but presents a broader vision of social well-being, institutional accountability, and balanced public life. Overall, the article argues that ancient Hindu political thought offers a coherent framework for understanding development, responsibility, and social sustainability.

title: Universal Stability and Robust Minimal Instability of First Clinch and Trade

detail.title: Universal Stability and Robust Minimal Instability of First Clinch and Trade
detail.abstract: We study how moving from unit to non-unit school capacities changes the stability structure of top-trading-cycles-type mechanisms. For a full-domain extension of First Clinch and Trade (FCT) with scalar capacities and strict priorities, we resolve the FCT component of the universal-stability classication problem that Do §an and Ehlers (2022) identied as a prerequisite for analysing robust minimal instability of non-unit-capacity TTC variants. For every xed capacity-priority structure, FCT is stable at every strict preference prole if and only if the structure contains no clinchaugmented cycle. This capacity-sensitive obstruction captures how early clinches change the trades that can create a blocking pair. The condition is polynomialtime recognisable and, at unit capacity, reduces exactly to Kesten's acyclicity. The extension is student Pareto ecient and unilaterally strategy-proof. Universal FCT stability implies robust minimal instability relative to admissible stability comparisons and deterministic mechanisms with these two properties. The converse holds on Ergin-acyclic structures and whenever all original school capacities are at least two; the latter result uses an obstruction-indexed whole-domain mechanism.

AI.method: 理论分析：对FCT机制进行全域扩展，提出"clinch-augmented cycle"条件来刻画容量敏感的不稳定性障碍，并构建基于障碍索引的全域机制。
AI.findings: （1）对每个固定的容量-优先级结构，FCT在每种严格偏好下稳定当且仅当结构中不含clinch-augmented cycle；（2）该条件可在多项式时间内识别，且在单位容量下精确退化为Kesten acyclicity；（3）扩展后的机制是学生帕累托有效的且单方面策略防护的；（4）普适FCT稳定性蕴含相对于可容许稳定性比较和具有这两个性质的确定性机制的鲁棒最小不稳定性；（5）逆命题在Ergin-acyclic结构和所有原始学校容量至少为2的结构上成立。

detail.title: How Much Do Global Geopolitical Conflicts Cost India? Evidence from Crude Oil Imports Using Counterfactual Time Series Analysis

declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a data analysis case study.

detail.abstract: India imports more than 85% of its crude oil requirement, making its economy highly vulnerable to geopolitical conflicts and global oil price shocks. This study estimates the additional crude oil import expenditure incurred by India during the Russia-Ukraine war and the recent USA-Iran conflict using a counterfactual scenario analysis and standard time series ARIMA forecasting. Monthly data on crude oil import quantity, Brent crude oil price, and the INR/USD exchange rate are used to estimate the import expenditure that would have occurred under pre-conflict conditions. The difference between the actual and counterfactual expenditure measures the additional financial burden associated with these conflicts. The study further decomposes the additional expenditure into quantity, oil price, and exchange rate effects. The results show that higher international crude oil prices were the main driver of the increase in India's import bill, while depreciation of the Indian Rupee further increased import costs. The findings highlight the importance of energy security, diversification of crude oil imports, and effective 1 exchange-rate risk management to reduce India's vulnerability to future geopolitical shocks. All R codes are available in author's GitHub repository and can be readily used: https://github.com/ganirban004/oil-import-paper.git.

AI.method: 使用月度数据（原油进口量、布伦特原油价格、INR/USD汇率），通过ARIMA模型预测反事实进口支出，对比实际支出计算差额，并进一步将差额分解为数量、油价和汇率三个效应。
AI.findings: 国际原油价格上涨是印度进口账单增加的主要驱动因素，印度卢比贬值进一步提高了进口成本，从而增加了印度在冲突期间的财政负担。

title: Prequential Benchmark of Limit Order Book Mid-Price Movement Prediction Models

detail.title: Prequential Benchmark of Limit Order Book Mid-Price Movement Prediction Models
detail.abstract: Predicting the direction of mid-price movements in highfrequency Limit Order Book (LOB) tick streams, where each tick is an individual trade transaction event, is the most demanding predictive modeling problem in financial machine learning. The tick stream is characterized by near-zero autocorrelation (ACF = 0.046 at lag 1), sample kurtosis of 1,282 (a measure of extreme fat-tailed return distributions) at the one-tick horizon, and microsecond latency requirements that render standard offline learning approaches inapplicable. This paper presents the most comprehensive prequential (test-then-train, zero-lookahead) benchmark of high-frequency LOB mid-price prediction to date: 10 baseline models across 10 trade horizons (ℎ ∈ {1. .. 500} ticks) evaluated on 11, 918, 929 BTC perpetual futures (continuously-rolling derivative contracts) ticks under a zero-leakage protocol, with full commercial return, risk-adjusted performance, and deployment efficiency analysis. Against this benchmark, Sticker, a biologicallyinspired, gradient-free continual learning model operating at O (1) computational depth, achieves 92.92% non-zero directional accuracy at ℎ = 1, a 14 𝜇s per-tick inference latency, and the maximum commercial signal edge of 0.10 bps (basis points; 1 bps = 0.01% of price) with an annualized Sharpe ratio of 3,913. Sticker establishes a new Pareto frontier (best accuracy at lowest latency simultaneously) across all evaluated architectures, confirming deployment viability from sub-millisecond scalping through sub-second short-swing trading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了高频限价订单簿（LOB）中盘中价格方向预测的最全面的前序基准测试，涵盖10个基线模型、10个交易视界、约1190万个BTC永续合约tick数据。作者提出了Sticker模型，一种受生物学启发的、无梯度的持续学习模型，以O(1)计算深度在1-tick视界实现92.92%的方向准确率、14微秒推理延迟和0.10 bps商业信号边际，年化Sharpe比率达3,913，在所有评估架构中建立了新的帕累托前沿。
AI.research_question: 在高频限价订单簿tick流中，如何在微秒级延迟约束下实现高精度的盘中价格（mid-price）移动方向预测？具体而言，哪种模型架构能在准确性与延迟之间达到最优帕累托前沿？
AI.motivation: 高频LOB tick流具有近零自相关、极端厚尾分布（样本峰度1,282）和微秒级延迟要求，使得标准离线学习方法不适用。现有文献缺乏全面、零泄露协议下的前序基准测试，也缺乏同时兼顾准确率与部署效率的模型方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物启发的持续学习理论（continual learning）、无梯度优化理论、前序（prequential）评估方法论（测试-训练、零前瞻协议）以及高频金融微观结构理论。
AI.method: 构建包含10个基线模型（涵盖传统机器学习和深度学习架构）在10个交易视界（1-500 ticks）上的全面前序基准测试框架，使用11,918,929条BTC永续期货tick数据，采用零泄露协议进行训练-测试划分。提出Sticker模型，一种受生物学启发的无梯度持续学习模型，以O(1)计算深度运行，并进行商业回报、风险调整绩效和部署效率的全方位分析。
AI.findings: Sticker模型在h=1时达到92.92%的非零方向准确率，每tick推理延迟为14微秒，商业信号边际最大为0.10 bps，年化Sharpe比率为3,913。Sticker在所有评估架构中建立了最佳准确率与最低延迟同时实现的新的帕累托前沿，证实了从亚毫秒剥头皮交易到亚秒短波段交易的部署可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了高频LOB预测领域最全面的前序基准测试框架（10个模型×10个视界×约1190万tick），建立零泄露评估协议的标准。提出Sticker模型证明生物启发的无梯度持续学习方法可在O(1)计算深度下超越传统深度学习方法，确立新的帕累托前沿概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频交易提供了经严格验证的模型选择基准和部署方案，Sticker模型的14微秒延迟和92.92%准确率满足亚毫秒级剥头皮交易的实际需求，并为从剥头皮到短波段交易的多时间尺度交易策略提供了统一的预测解决方案。

title: Understanding Sensitivity Analysis, Scenario Analysis, Stress Testing, and Monte Carlo Simulation: A Practical Framework for Risk Analysis

detail.title: Understanding Sensitivity Analysis, Scenario Analysis, Stress Testing, and Monte Carlo Simulation: A Practical Framework for Risk Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no personal or financial relationships with individuals or organisations that could have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, the conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study.

detail.abstract: Risk analysis plays a central role in decision-making across corporate finance, project appraisal, banking, insurance, and enterprise risk management. However, commonly applied techniques such as sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and reverse stress testing are often discussed independently, creating ambiguity regarding their respective purposes, differences, and interrelationships. This paper develops an accessible and integrated framework for understanding these techniques within the broader distinction between risk and uncertainty. Building on Knight’s (1921) conceptualisation, the paper first distinguishes measurable risk from broader uncertainty and then explains the progression from deterministic to stochastic approaches to risk analysis. Using a hypothetical solar power plant investment as a common illustrative case, the paper demonstrates how sensitivity analysis identifies critical value drivers; scenario analysis evaluates alternative combinations of future conditions; Monte Carlo simulation generates a probability distribution of potential outcomes; VaR quantifies downside exposure at specified confidence levels; stress testing assesses resilience under severe but plausible conditions; and reverse stress testing identifies the combinations of circumstances that could lead to financial failure. Rather than treating these methods as competing techniques, the paper positions them as complementary components of an integrated risk-analysis process, progressing from risk identification and deterministic assessment towards probabilistic modelling, downside-risk measurement, resilience assessment, and failure-point identification. The framework provides a practical bridge between theoretical concepts and applied risk analysis and offers a foundation for extending these techniques to emerging areas such as climate-risk assessment, infrastructure investment, and strategic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个整合性的风险分析框架，区分可测度风险与更广泛的不确定性（基于Knight 1921的概念），并通过太阳能电站投资案例系统展示了敏感性分析、情景分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、VaR、压力测试和反向压力测试六种技术如何作为互补工具共同构成从风险识别到失败点识别的完整风险分析流程。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合性的框架来理解敏感性分析、情景分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、VaR、压力测试和反向压力测试等风险分析技术之间的目的、差异和相互关系？
AI.motivation: 常用风险分析技术通常被孤立讨论，导致对其各自目的、差异和相互关系存在模糊性；需要在风险与不确定性的大框架下厘清这些技术的内在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Knight（1921）的风险与不确定性区分理论；确定性到随机方法的风险分析演进逻辑。
AI.method: 采用假设性太阳能电站投资作为统一案例，逐一演示六种风险分析技术的应用方式及其在整合流程中的定位。
AI.findings: 六种风险分析技术并非竞争性方法，而是整合性风险分析过程中互补的组成部分，按从风险识别、确定性评估、概率建模、下行风险测量、韧性评估到失败点识别的顺序递进。
AI.theory_contributions: 为区分风险和不确定性背景下理解多种风险分析工具提供了统一的概念框架，弥合了理论概念与应用实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业财务、项目评估、银行、保险和企业风险管理等领域的从业者提供了实用的整合性风险分析流程指南，并可推广至气候风险评估、基础设施投资和战略韧性等新兴领域。
